y1: Ten girls took their lamps and waited for the bridegroom. Five of them had prepared enough oil, but the other five had not.
y2: When the bridegroom came late at night, the five girls who were ready went into the wedding, but the five who went to buy oil couldn't go in. We who are waiting for Jesus must always be ready too.
y3: The talents entrusted by the master
y4: A master going on a journey entrusted his servants with talents. He gave five to one, two to another, and one to another.
y5: The servants who received five and two talents worked hard and doubled them. But the servant who received one talent dug a hole in the ground and hid the money.
y6: Well done, good and faithful servant
y7: The master returned and said to his hardworking servants, 'Well done, good and faithful servant! You were faithful over a few things, I will put you in charge of many things.'
y8: But the servant who hid the one talent said, 'I hid it because I was afraid of you.' The master scolded the lazy servant who didn't use what was entrusted to him. We shouldn't hide the abilities God gives us; we must use them.
y10: On the day Jesus comes as King, He will say, 'I was hungry, and you gave me food; I was thirsty, and you gave me a drink; I was sick, and you cared for me.'
y11: When people ask, 'When?', the King will answer, 'Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of mine, you did it for me.' If we help a friend in need, we are helping Jesus.
verse: “Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of mine, you did it for me.”
prayer: Jesus, thank You for entrusting me with abilities and time. Let me always be ready like the wise girls, and use the talent I received without hiding it. When I help a friend in need, let me remember that I am helping You. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: lamp. It is a small bowl that is filled with oil and lit. The girls took their lamps and waited.
d1: talent. It is a very large amount of money. It means the abilities and opportunities God gives us. The master entrusted talents to his servants.
d2: faithful. Someone who does the work given to them diligently until the end. Well done, good and faithful servant!
d3: brother. Someone close like family. Jesus calls those in need His brothers. To one of the least of these brothers.
